preserve.item: 시딩 정의(요청 전에 미리 렌더링해 캐시에서 제공)
preserve.evidence: Seeding pre-renders tiles so they are served from the cache instead of being rendered on demand.
`--zoom` takes a range of zoom levels.
`--bbox` takes a bounding box in the order `minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat`.

preserve.item: --bbox 생략 시 전체 범위, 전 지구 레이어에서 매우 오래 걸림
preserve.evidence: If you omit `--bbox`, the layer's full extent is used, which can take a very long time for global layers.
`geotile seed` uses 4 worker processes by default. You can change this with `--workers`.

preserve.item: 워커당 약 600 MB, 측정 조건, 벡터 레이어 단서
preserve.evidence: Each worker uses roughly 600 MB of memory. We measured this on our reference setup (raster layers, 256px tiles, PNG output). Vector layers with many features may use considerably more.
Existing tiles are skipped by default. Pass `--force` to overwrite them.

preserve.item: --force는 bbox 밖 타일을 지우지 않고 안쪽만 재렌더링
preserve.evidence: `--force` only re-renders tiles inside the bounding box. It does not delete tiles outside it.

- Seeding vector layers above zoom 16 is not supported.
- Seeding cannot be resumed after interruption yet. If the process stops, run it again. Already rendered tiles are skipped unless `--force` is set.
- The S3 storage backend is experimental for seeding. It has only been tested with AWS S3, not with S3-compatible services such as MinIO.

must_not.item: 명령, 옵션 이름, 좌표, 좌표 순서 표기 바꾸기
600 MB 수치에서 측정 조건 또는 벡터 레이어 단서 삭제
must_not.evidence: We measured this on our reference setup (raster layers, 256px tiles, PNG output). Vector layers with many features may use considerably more.

must_not.item: --force가 bbox 밖 타일을 지운다고 쓰거나 대조 삭제
must_not.evidence: It does not delete tiles outside it.

must_not.item: 재개 기능이나 MinIO 지원이 있거나 곧 추가된다고 쓰기
must_not.evidence: Seeding cannot be resumed after interruption yet.
